data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [No phone number to call](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/659c9c0c84adaac64e278a1e)
No phone number to call! All contact and complaints are carried out through email, where my concerns over my saggy, awful looking couch were brushed off. Very disappointed!!

December 25, 2023

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jan 9, 2024

Hi Carolyn,

Thank you so much for reaching out to us. We're genuinely sorry to hear that the couch hasn't met your expectations and that the lack of a direct phone line has added to your frustration. We want to assure you that your comfort and satisfaction are our top priorities.

We do offer a live Chat service available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM PST, where you can have a real-time conversation with our Customer Experience team. They're always ready to assist with any issues or concerns you might have.

For more detailed assistance regarding your couch, we encourage you to email us at support@luluandgeorgia.com. Our team is dedicated to addressing your concerns thoroughly and providing you with the support you need.
